report:
Reviewed the complete body_local_quiescence claim, all six implementation entries and both test entries; captured the surrounding inference design. Source inspection only, with no behavioral suites rerun and no source changes.

The claim requires body-local ownership of inference state and successful publication only after all tree types resolve and tasks, obligations and speculative branches are no longer live. LocalFnSym::body constructs a fresh InferCtx for its own CST and signature, runs body checking, calls finalize and then consumes the context through finish. InferCtx::new initializes its own egraph, runtime, obligation manager, expression slots and pending wakes, rather than returning these as shared query products. finalize processes enabled obligations, fallback/final bounds and unresolved-variable diagnostics, retries and terminally discharges retained obligations, then flushes/drains wakes and runtime work.

The finish association enforces the final boundary: ObligationManager::has_pending treats every non-Terminal entry as live; VersionTree::is_leaf(ROOT) rejects remaining children; Runtime::is_quiescent requires both its task table and ready queue to be empty; pending_wakes must be empty and every expression slot filled. Runtime draining removes completed tasks and their waiter registrations. Terminal obligation records may remain as history until the consumed context drops, but are not live work. finalize_typed_body structurally copies the returned tree into a fresh stash, resolves egraph representatives throughout nested types, and panics if an unresolved InferVar remains reachable. CheckedBody receives the completed body and diagnostics, not the runtime, version tree or obligation registry. These six associated implementations collectively account for the ownership and completion mechanics.

The ordinary body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash test exercises a narrow part of that boundary: it binds an inference variable to i32, embeds it in a tuple expression type, finalizes, verifies the source remains InferVar(0), and traverses the completed tuple to require i32. This provides a real nested-type resolution assertion. It directly calls the finalizer and therefore does not verify that finish rejects pending tasks, obligations or branches, nor does it inspect a representative whole checked source body.

The sole other entry, inference_body_local_quiescence, is explicitly TODO with no assertions. It requires representative inference-free tree inspection, finish rejection with live variables/obligations/tasks/branches, and separately specified diagnostic recovery. Completing those positive and negative boundary tests is the prerequisite for full verification. I preserve that deferral and do not equate inspected guards or the nested-type unit test with complete quiescence coverage. Successful output must remain distinguished from diagnosed recovery. All evidence entries and claim requirements are accounted for; no concrete defect was identified in the inspected paths and no additional edits are requested.
